name: getpeppr
description: Peppol e-invoicing for developers. Connects Cursor to getpeppr's hosted MCP server: plan your Peppol integration, search the getpeppr docs, check a test invoice against the Peppol rules, look up a Peppol receiver and send sandbox test invoices. Cursor asks you to sign in with a free getpeppr account when it connects. Sandbox only: it never sends a real invoice.
